title: Wait for the network, not the clock
summary: Start waiting for the /api/orders response before clicking 'Load orders', then assert on both the JSON and the UI.
why: Sometimes you need the data the page received (an order id, a total). waitForResponse gives you the real response without guessing a delay.
objectives: const responsePromise = page.waitForResponse(…) before the click
Assert the page shows as many list items as the API returned

requires.reason: Wait for the network: const responsePromise = page.waitForResponse(…) before clicking 'Load orders'.

mutants.reason: the orders API never returns any orders
